title: Longest Consecutive Sequence

monster.name: Continuum Hydra
monster.title: Beast of Broken Sequences
monster.defeatQuote: You tracked consecutive intervals in O(n) without sorting!

description: Given an unsorted array of integers `nums`, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence. You must write an algorithm that runs in O(n) time.
hints: Store elements in a set. Only begin counting when `num - 1` is not in the set.
